description.name: VoxSentinel Enhanced MFCC Candidate
description.description: Enhanced-feature candidate detector (delta-MFCC + spectral shape) trained by the multi-dataset pipeline; see its training report for provenance and calibration status.

inference.raw_score_definition: Estimated P(synthetic) from the explicitly calibrated classifier; calibration is limited to the artifact's validation distribution.
inference.uncertainty_method: Classifier margin: 1 - 2*abs(p - 0.5). Higher means nearer the decision boundary; this is NOT a validated error probability and does not measure out-of-distribution uncertainty.
inference.explanation: Grouped feature-occlusion sensitivity (replacement score minus original score): MFCC means: -0.0312506; MFCC standard deviations: -0.00954929; delta-MFCC means: -0.00981291; delta-MFCC standard deviations: +0.00445341; spectral shape: -0.047469. Each group was replaced by fitted scaler training means; other features were held fixed. These are actual model score changes, not causal proof or additive contributions; replacement vectors may not correspond to realistic audio.
